newsitem.title: USA: Ill. riverboat casino June revenues down 12.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ill. riverboat casino June revenues down 12.48 pct.

text.p: Illinois riverboat casino revenues dropped 12.48 percent in June from May and were off 12.93 percent from June 1996, the Illinois Gaming Board said.
Gross adjusted receipts totalled $81.23 million for June, down from $92.81 reported in May and $93.3 million in June 1996, according to the board.
The casinos reported $528.62 million in adjusted gross receipts through June, down about 13 percent from the first six months of 1996.
The board also reported an overall drop in admissions of 8.38 percent for June compared to May and 6.29 percent compared to June 1996.
